title: RAC: A Relational Agent Contract for Constraint-Governed Engineering Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Engineering agents must produce artifacts that satisfy exact, coupled constraints. Existing solutions often require agents to make semantic decisions and also derive consequences such as precise geometry or timing from those decisions, leading to failures in constraint-governed engineering tasks. In this paper, we introduce RAC, a harness-agnostic contract for the action and feedback layer of engineering agents. It specifies authoritative observations, semantic actions, tool-based realization, independent verification, and repair evidence. The agent decides which relations an artifact should satisfy; specialized tools derive their concrete consequences. On PCB placement, routing, and repair tasks, RAC achieves the highest clean-pass rate for all nine evaluated models, averaging 90.9%, compared with 74.0% for the strongest baseline, requirements-only delegation. In job-shop scheduling, direct relational actions achieve 96.3% quality pass

translated_title: RAC：面向约束驱动工程任务的关系型智能体契约
translated_abstract: 工程智能体必须生成满足精确且相互耦合约束的产物。现有解决方案通常要求智能体既做出语义决策，又要从这些决策中推导出精确几何或时序等具体后果，从而导致在约束驱动的工程任务中失败。在本文中，我们提出了RAC，一种与执行框架无关的工程智能体动作与反馈层契约。它规定了权威观测、语义动作、基于工具的具体实现、独立验证和修复证据。智能体只需决定产物应满足哪些关系，而由专门的工具推导出其具体后果。在PCB布局、布线和修复任务上，RAC在所有九个受评估模型中都取得了最高的纯净通过率，平均为90.9%，而最强基线（仅需求委托）为74.0%。在作业车间调度中，直接关系动作达到了96.3%的质量通过率。
tldr: 提出RAC契约，将工程智能体的语义决策与具体后果推导相分离，通过“智能体决定关系、工具实现细节”的分工，在PCB设计与作业车间调度等约束驱动任务上显著提升通过率。
en_tdlr: RAC, a harness-agnostic contract for engineering agents that separates semantic decision-making from tool-based derivation of concrete consequences, achieving a 90.9% clean-pass rate on PCB tasks versus 74.0% for the strongest baseline.
